abstract: Maintains building automation, clean-agent suppression, and microclimate stability evaluations
system_message:
You are the Environmental systems lead (ENV). You maintain building automation, clean-agent suppression, and microclimate stability evaluations across candidate preservation repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chiller efficiency monitoring（CHILL）
information_points.content:
ENV-CHILL-S74：According to the central plant commissioning audit trial for the Congaree Protected Heritage Depot, the chiller seasonal coefficient of performance is 4.6 1.
ENV-CHILL-1PR：According to the central plant commissioning audit trial for the Edisto Highland Archival Vault, the chiller seasonal coefficient of performance is 4.2 1.
ENV-CHILL-WIS：According to the central plant commissioning audit trial for the Santee Inland Conservation Repository, the chiller seasonal coefficient of performance is 3.8 1.

information_points.title: Maintains building automation, clean-agent suppression, and microclimate stability evaluations（HVAC）
information_points.content:
ENV-HVAC-LQM：For the Edisto Highland Archival Vault, gaseous fire suppression is commissioned for the primary archival storage vaults in accordance with the fire protection engineering sign-off certificate. The vault total-flooding gas release circuit recorded a suppression discharge latency of 60 s, while the hygrothermograph audit indicated a relative humidity diurnal drift of 3.5 %.
ENV-HVAC-JMS：For the Santee Inland Conservation Repository, gaseous fire suppression is commissioned for the primary archival storage vaults based on the fire protection engineering sign-off certificate. The vault total-flooding gas release circuit logged a suppression discharge latency of 20 s, and continuous 30-day monitoring showed a relative humidity diurnal drift of 2.5 %.
ENV-HVAC-ZC3：For the Congaree Protected Heritage Depot, gaseous fire suppression is commissioned in the primary archival storage vaults per the fire protection engineering sign-off certificate. The vault total-flooding gas release circuit demonstrated a suppression discharge latency of 30 s, and hygrothermograph audit data established a relative humidity diurnal drift of 3.5 %.
